name: Massdriver
long_description: Massdriver is a platform orchestrator for governed infrastructure change and an internal developer platform for teams using Terraform, OpenTofu, and Helm. Platform teams publish the infrastructure they already maintain as approved capabilities with typed inputs and dependencies. Developers, CI, automation, and AI agents request changes through the same governed path, where Massdriver applies policy, permissions, and approvals before executing with platform-held credentials. Every deploy records who proposed and approved the change, and Massdriver creates an ephemeral execution workflow per deployment rather than requiring teams to maintain standing infrastructure pipelines. Massdriver can be managed or self-hosted in the customer's cloud or security boundary.
one_liner: Platform orchestrator for governed infrastructure change
